[NSBK.6.3] **The aggregations are the registry `specs/registry/series_agg.ebnf`.**
libds's internal mirror of it is held to it by [ISBK.1.1]. A member's value is
also its bit in a backend's `supported_aggs`, so no allocation may exceed 63.
Values 10–14 are allocated, not members, and never
reissued ([STYL.2.8.7]).

A series has meaning only to the rules
that read it, and its values reach an integrator only through what those rules
do: a call, or a fact they emit or publish.
